title: The One Who Earned a Surah
intro: Imagine a humble soul approaching one of Allah's Messengers with a heart full of sincerity and a deep yearning to learn. Yet at that very moment, a person of wealth and status held the Messenger's attention, and a frown was directed at the seeker. What followed was nothing less than an entire chapter of the Quran, sent to correct the Messenger and honor the soul who came seeking.
clues: I came to a Messenger of Allah with an open heart and a deep yearning for guidance
I had no worldly status to offer, only a humble soul seeking truth
My physical eyes could not see, but my spiritual vision was clear
I arrived at an inconvenient moment, when the Messenger was occupied with a person of great influence
A frown was turned toward me, but Allah responded with divine correction
I am Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum, the devoted companion whose story inspired Surah Abasa
